name: ImageLightbox
description:
A lightbox for result images: the library's Lightbox (previous / next, swipe, zoom and
pan, thumbnails) fed with the result's images. ← → move between images, + and − zoom,
0 fits.
signature: ({ images, index, onIndexChange, open, onOpenChange }: LightboxProps): import("react").JSX.Element | null

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the zero-based index to show next, from previous / next or ← → (wrapping at the ends). Pair with `index`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` when the person dismisses the dialog, for example with Esc. Pair with `open`.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.
